methodology.purpose: Classification and execution planning only. No Ṣarf row is authored, changed, upgraded, downgraded or propagated in this phase.
methodology.candidateEvidence: Potential same-root forms are existing project-authored rows discovered by root; they remain research leads and are not approved candidates.

groups.C3-A: Secure regular or derived verb family; investigate established tense, voice, maṣdar and participle contrasts first.
groups.C3-B: Rootful noun/adjective with secure identity and multiple already-discoverable same-root derivational signals; verify sense alignment before authoring.
groups.C3-C: Weak, hamzated, doubled, quadriliteral, irregular, or root/lemma-normalisation risk; morphology evidence must be checked before row authoring.
groups.C3-D: Semantic branching is the main difficulty; same-root forms may be useful, but each branch needs an honest meaning and sense-scoped evidence.
groups.C3-E: Frozen, grammatical, proper-name, or model-dependent item; decide whether a dedicated learner representation is needed rather than fabricating Ṣarf rows.

batchPlan.selectionRule: Within the group: secure root/lemma first, then occurrence count, then strongest existing same-root evidence; hardest semantic or normalization cases last.
